nodes.description: Constructor: creates Uniswap V2 pair, stores router/pair, seeds exclusions, blacklists address(0), sets buyFee=110/sellFee=170 and mints 10**12 tokens to owner.
Empty receive() payable fallback that accepts ETH into the contract.
Overridden transfer: blacklist check, trading-enabled gate, 200s post-launch buy limit, sell-limit via router quote, fee logic, and swap/liquify/dividend triggering before final transfer.
Splits contract token balance in half, swaps half for ETH, then adds liquidity with the pair.
Approves the router and swaps contract tokens for ETH using swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with block.timestamp deadline.
Approves the router and calls addLiquidityETH with ETH value, minting LP tokens to owner().
Swaps tokens for ETH then forwards the entire contract ETH balance to owner().
onlyOwner setter that writes an address flag into _isBlacklisted.
onlyOwner function enabling trading and recording startTime = block.timestamp.
onlyOwner setter for the swapTokensAtAmount threshold.
onlyOwner setter for maxSellAmt.
onlyOwner setter for buyFee.
onlyOwner setter for sellFee.
onlyOwner function transferring ownership of the contract.
View function returning the stored owner address.
uint256 buy fee in basis points (out of 1000); set to 110 in constructor.
uint256 sell fee in basis points (out of 1000); set to 170 in constructor.
Private boolean re-entrancy guard flag set while the contract swaps tokens.
Private boolean gate controlling whether non-excluded addresses may trade.
Private timestamp of trading launch used for the 200s post-launch buy cap.
Public threshold of contract token balance that triggers auto swap/liquify.
Public maximum ETH value returned from a sell quote before transfer is blocked.
IUniswapV2Router02 router used for swaps, quotes and liquidity.
Immutable address of the token/WETH Uniswap V2 pair.
Mapping of addresses excluded from fees and from the trading-enabled gate.
Public mapping of blacklisted addresses blocked from sending or receiving.
Private owner address used by onlyOwner checks and as privileged fee recipient.
Caller address used for ownership checks, transfer source and blacklist/exclusion lookups.
Block timestamp used for the launch timing gate and as swap/liquidity deadlines.
External call to the router swapping tokens for ETH, executed inside a token transfer path.
External payable call adding ETH/token liquidity to the router.
payable(owner()).transfer(address(this).balance) that drains all ETH to the owner.
External view call to the router to quote sell output used for maxSellAmt enforcement.
Raw multiplication 10**12 * (10**18) used as the initial mint amount without SafeMath.
Raw multiplication 5**9 * (5**18) used in the post-launch maximum buy requirement without SafeMath.
Source address argument of the overridden _transfer.
Destination address argument of the overridden _transfer.
Token amount argument of the overridden _transfer.
Token amount to be split and liquified.
Token amount approved and swapped for ETH.
Token amount used in addLiquidityETH.
ETH value forwarded to the router addLiquidityETH call.
Token amount swapped then fully paid out as ETH to owner.
Address key written into the blacklist mapping.
Boolean blacklist flag written for the account.
New threshold value written to swapTokensAtAmount.
New value written to maxSellAmt.
New value written to buyFee.
New value written to sellFee.
New owner address written to _owner.
Cached balanceOf(address(this)) used to decide whether to swap.
Boolean deciding auto swap-and-liquify execution.
One percent of contract token balance used for liquidity.
Remaining contract token balance sent as dividends.
Flag controlling whether buy/sell fees are deducted.
Computed fee amount based on buyFee or sellFee.
Swap path array [token, WETH] used for the sell quote.
Amounts returned by uniswapV2Router.getAmountsOut.
Half of the tokens to be swapped for ETH.
Remaining tokens used to add liquidity.
ETH balance snapshot taken before the swap.
ETH received from the swap, computed as balance delta.
Local router instance created from the hardcoded mainnet router address.
Local pair address produced by factory createPair.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns _owner from _msgSender(), i.e. msg.sender, making ownership caller-controlled at deployment.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner, which compares _owner with _msgSender().
setBlacklist privileged call gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
enableTrading privileged call gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
setSwapAtAmount privileged call gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
setMaxSellAmt privileged call gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
setBuyFee privileged call gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
setSellFee privileged call gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
msg.sender becomes the from address when transfer/transferFrom invoke _transfer.
Caller-controlled addresses are looked up in the _isBlacklisted mapping inside _transfer.
Caller-controlled addresses are looked up in the _isExcluded mapping for fee and trading bypass.
enableTrading stores block.timestamp into startTime, making the launch window timestamp dependent.
enableTrading behavior depends on the miner-influenced block.timestamp.
_transfer uses block.timestamp - startTime < 200 to cap buys, a timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline to the router.
_transfer invokes swapAndLiquify (external swaps) before finishing its own balance and fee accounting.
_transfer invokes swapAndSendDividends which sends ETH to owner in the middle of the transfer flow.
swapAndLiquify performs an external token-to-ETH swap via swapTokensForEth.
swapAndLiquify performs an external payable addLiquidityETH call.
swapAndSendDividends swaps tokens for ETH through swapTokensForEth before paying out.
swapAndSendDividends sends the entire contract ETH balance to owner() after the swap.
swapTokensForEth executes the external router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call.
addLiquidity executes the external payable router addLiquidityETH call.
_transfer makes an external getAmountsOut quote call to the router for the sell limit check.
_transfer reads and writes the swapping flag used as an ad-hoc re-entrancy guard.
buyFee is read in _transfer to compute the buy fee.
sellFee is read in _transfer to compute the sell fee.
swapTokensAtAmount is read to decide whether the auto-swap triggers.
maxSellAmt is compared against the quoted sell output.
isTradingEnabled gates whether non-excluded addresses may transfer.
_isExcluded bypasses the trading gate and fee deduction in _transfer.
_isBlacklisted entries revert transfers in _transfer.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to identify buys and sells.
uniswapV2Router is used to build the path and quote sell amounts.
setBuyFee writes the privileged buyFee state variable.
setSellFee writes the privileged sellFee state variable.
setSwapAtAmount writes the swap threshold state variable.
setMaxSellAmt writes the sell cap state variable.
setBlacklist writes the _isBlacklisted mapping, allowing the owner to block any address.
enableTrading flips isTradingEnabled, opening trading to all holders.
enableTrading writes startTime from the current block timestamp.
transferOwnership writes the _owner state variable.
Constructor creates the pair through the factory and stores it in uniswapV2Pair.
Constructor stores the hardcoded router instance in uniswapV2Router.
Constructor excludes owner() and the contract itself from fees by writing _isExcluded.
Constructor blacklists address(0) by writing _isBlacklisted.
Constructor initializes buyFee to 110.
Constructor initializes sellFee to 170.
Constructor computes the mint amount with raw multiplication instead of SafeMath.
_transfer computes 5**9 * 5**18 with raw multiplication inside the buy-limit requirement.
swapAndSendDividends pays the ETH balance to the address returned by owner().
addLiquidity mints liquidity tokens to the address returned by owner().
from parameter drives blacklist, exclusion, pair and transfer logic in _transfer.
to parameter drives blacklist, exclusion, pair and transfer logic in _transfer.
amount parameter drives fee subtraction, sell checks and transfer amounts.
tokens parameter is split into half/otherHalf in swapAndLiquify.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and paired with ETH in addLiquidity.
ethAmount parameter is forwarded as msg.value to the router.
tokens parameter is swapped then the resulting ETH balance is paid to owner.
account parameter is the mapping key written by setBlacklist.
value parameter is the boolean written into the blacklist mapping.
amount parameter is written into swapTokensAtAmount.
amount parameter is written into maxSellAmt.
value parameter is written into buyFee.
value parameter is written into sellFee.
newOwner parameter is written into _owner by transferOwnership.
contractTokenBalance caches balanceOf(address(this)) in _transfer.
canSwap controls whether the swap/liquify block runs.
swapTokens derives one percent of the contract balance for liquifying.
sellTokens is the remaining contract balance sent as dividends.
takeFee decides whether buy/sell fees are deducted.
fees holds the computed fee amount transferred to the contract.
path array is built for the sell quote.
amounts holds the router quote compared against maxSellAmt.
half is half of tokens, used for the ETH swap.
otherHalf is the remainder paired with ETH in addLiquidity.
initialBalance snapshots contract ETH before the swap.
newBalance is the ETH received, used as liquidity value.
Local router instance is used by the constructor to create the pair.
Local pair address is stored into uniswapV2Pair by the constructor.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter is a per-call argument fully consumed by _transfer; fold it into the _transfer function node.
The to parameter is a per-call argument fully consumed by _transfer; fold it into the _transfer function node.
The amount parameter only feeds fee math and transfers inside _transfer; fold it into the _transfer function node.
tokens parameter is only used inside swapAndLiquify; fold it into the swapAndLiquify function node.
tokenAmount parameter is only used by swapTokensForEth; fold it into the swapTokensForEth function node.
tokenAmount parameter is only used inside addLiquidity; fold it into the addLiquidity function node.
ethAmount becomes the msg.value of the external addLiquidityETH call, so fold it into that unsafe operation node.
tokens parameter is only used by swapAndSendDividends; fold it into the swapAndSendDividends function node.
account parameter is only the mapping key of setBlacklist; fold it into the setBlacklist function node.
value parameter is only the boolean written by setBlacklist; fold it into the setBlacklist function node.
amount parameter is only written to state by setSwapAtAmount; fold it into the setSwapAtAmount function node.
amount parameter is only written to state by setMaxSellAmt; fold it into the setMaxSellAmt function node.
value parameter is only written to state by setBuyFee; fold it into the setBuyFee function node.
value parameter is only written to state by setSellFee; fold it into the setSellFee function node.
newOwner parameter is only written to _owner by transferOwnership; fold it into the transferOwnership function node.
contractTokenBalance is a short-lived local used only inside _transfer; fold it into the _transfer function node.
canSwap is a boolean local evaluated only in _transfer; fold it into the _transfer function node.
swapTokens is a local computed and consumed only inside _transfer; fold it into the _transfer function node.
sellTokens is a local computed and consumed only inside _transfer; fold it into the _transfer function node.
takeFee is a local flag used only by _transfer; fold it into the _transfer function node.
fees is a local derived from buyFee/sellFee inside _transfer; fold it into the _transfer function node.
path is a local swap path array built only inside _transfer; fold it into the _transfer function node.
amounts is the return data of the external getAmountsOut quote, so fold it into that unsafe operation node.
half is a local derived from tokens inside swapAndLiquify; fold it into the swapAndLiquify function node.
otherHalf is a local derived from tokens inside swapAndLiquify; fold it into the swapAndLiquify function node.
initialBalance is a balance snapshot local used only in swapAndLiquify; fold it into the swapAndLiquify function node.
newBalance is a local ETH delta used only in swapAndLiquify; fold it into the swapAndLiquify function node.
The local router instance exists only during construction; fold it into the constructor node.
The local pair address exists only during construction; fold it into the constructor node.
